tests.name: Restricted VLAN Internal Isolation
tests.prerequisite: WS-SYD is currently in VLAN40 Restricted
tests.expected: VLAN40 cannot reach VLAN10 or VLAN20 gateways.

steps.instructions:
Execute locally on WS-SYD. SDDC has no SSH control path to the endpoint while VLAN40 isolation is working correctly.

Confirm WS-SYD is on VLAN40 Restricted.
Expected network: 10.10.5.0/25
Expected gateway: 10.10.5.1

Run on WS-SYD:

Test-Connection 10.10.0.1 -Count 2 -Quiet
Test-Connection 10.10.4.1 -Count 2 -Quiet

Expected:
False
False

tests.prerequisite: WS-SYD is currently in VLAN40 Restricted
tests.expected: VLAN40 cannot reach the simulated Internet.

steps.instructions:

tests.name: Restricted VLAN Management SSH Isolation
tests.prerequisite: WS-SYD is currently in VLAN40 Restricted
tests.expected: VLAN40 cannot establish SSH to the management network.

steps.instructions:
Execute locally on WS-SYD. SDDC has no SSH control path to the endpoint while VLAN40 isolation is working correctly.

Confirm WS-SYD is on VLAN40 Restricted.

Run on WS-SYD:

Test-NetConnection 10.10.6.65 -Port 22 -InformationLevel Quiet

Expected:
False

tests.name: Staff VLAN Access Control
tests.prerequisite: WS-SYD is authenticated as test.staff and assigned to VLAN10
tests.expected: WS-SYD receives a VLAN10 address, can reach CYBERDYNE-T800, and cannot reach VLAN99 management.

tests.name: IT Admin Management Access
tests.prerequisite: WS-SYD is authenticated as test.itadmin and assigned to VLAN60
tests.expected: WS-SYD receives a VLAN60 address and can reach both Sydney management switch addresses.

tests.name: Guest VLAN Access Control
tests.prerequisite: Test workstation is connected to SYD-SW1 Gi1/0/6 in VLAN30 Guest
tests.expected: Guest cannot reach VLAN10/VLAN20 or management SSH, but can reach the simulated Internet.

tests.name: Guest VLAN DHCP Operation
tests.prerequisite: Test workstation is connected to VLAN30 Guest and uses DHCP
tests.expected: Guest client receives the correct VLAN30 address, gateway 10.10.4.129, DNS 10.10.4.10, and appears in CBR-GW DHCP bindings.

tests.name: Port Security
tests.expected: Gi1/0/3 is Secure-up, maximum MAC addresses is 3, sticky MAC addresses are learned, and violation count is 0.

tests.name: Core DNS Service
tests.expected: WS-SYD uses 10.10.4.10 for DNS and both domain and AD DNS queries resolve successfully.

tests.name: Cisco NTP Synchronisation
tests.expected: Cisco device clock is synchronized with reference 10.10.4.10.

tests.name: OSPF Routing
tests.expected: Required OSPF adjacencies are FULL, including SYD-GW to CBR-GW across Tunnel0, and remote site networks are learned through OSPF.

tests.name: GRE over IPsec VPN
tests.expected: Tunnel0 is up/up, tunnel peer responds, IKEv2 is READY, IPsec is active, AES-256/SHA-256 are in use, packet counters increase, and send/receive errors remain zero.

tests.name: NAT/PAT Sydney
tests.expected: WS-SYD reaches 17.155.127.65 and SYD-GW creates NAT/PAT translations with increasing statistics.

tests.name: NAT/PAT Canberra
tests.expected: WS-CBR reaches 17.155.127.65 and CBR-GW creates NAT/PAT translations with increasing statistics.

tests.name: 802.1X Logged-Out State (VLAN40 Restricted)
tests.prerequisite: WS-SYD is connected to SYD-SW2 GigabitEthernet1/0/3.
tests.expected: Logged-out WS-SYD is assigned VLAN40, and the authentication session (if any) reflects no successful 802.1X login.

steps.instructions: Operator ensures WS-SYD is logged out of any 802.1X account, then confirms. T1000 reconnects to WS-SYD once the resulting IP settles.

tests.name: EtherChannel and Link Resilience
tests.prerequisite: Port-channel1 is up with both members bundled on SYD-SW1 and SYD-SW2.
tests.expected: Po1 remains up with one member during the outage, connectivity continues with little/no interruption, and the restored link returns to bundled state.

steps.instructions: Operator manually shuts one EtherChannel member interface (simulating link failure), then confirms.
Operator restores (no shutdown) the previously shut member interface, then confirms.

tests.name: Cross-Site 1 GB File Transfer
tests.prerequisite: C:\Test and \\WS-CBR\TestShare exist and SMB access is available.
tests.expected: The 1 GB file transfers successfully in both directions with no transfer errors and throughput is recorded in Kbps.
